text:
I built K-DECK with Jev.

A live Trading Decision Terminal. Jev is TypeSafe’s System One model. It doesn’t write analysis. It doesn’t hallucinate a thesis.

You give it market state and a closed set of questions. It comes back with typed decisions, probabilities, and confidence —…
headline: A live Trading Decision Terminal.
